author: Chan619
quote: I own both the PS5 and the Xbox Series X, and honestly, there's not much difference. The game is full of bugs, not very relevant, and overrated. The critics are sellouts; they don't write real reviews. The quality is 100% better than this one, and $80 plus tax for an empty box and a cheap, low-quality poster that doesn't even include the typical game map. Don't waste your money.

author: Chan619
quote: It's the same masterpiece from the late '90s but with a modern twist. The story is fantastic, the cutscenes are excellent and fit perfectly into the game's narrative and plot. 100% recommended. It's a must-have game if you own a Switch 2, and I pre-ordered it from Walmart for $54—a great price for such an excellent game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Chan619
quote: I bought the standard version to see what it was like, but it's a disappointment. The game is full of bugs, the resolution is terrible, the frame rate isn't stable, and it has very noticeable drops. I think calling it good is giving it too much credit, and the price doesn't justify what it offers. A code in a box with a poster isn't enough, and there were too many pre-orders due to FOMO. It's an overrated game; it's not worth the price. GTA 5 or San Andreas are 100% better.
